The '''Ord Pardron system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]].
